### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, activities A15, A16, A25, A26 and A27 occurred in every trace (100% participation). In the later window, none of them appear (0% participation). [OCC002, OCC003, OCC008, OCC009, OCC010]
- In the earlier window, activities A14, A17, A18, A19 and A20 were absent. In the later window, they appear in about 18%, 24%, 21%, 22% and 16% of traces respectively. [OCC001, OCC004, OCC005, OCC006, OCC007]
- A28 and A43 remain present in all traces in both windows. [POS011, POS012, REL018, REL019]
- The outgoing transitions of A43 changed: before it led to A15, A16, A25, A26 and A27; after it leads to A14, A17, A18, A19 and A20. [DIR011]
- The new activities (A14, A17, A18, A19, A20) all lead to A28. [DIR001, DIR004, DIR005, DIR006, DIR007]
- The position of A28 moved earlier (mean from 0.46 to 0.39) and A43 moved later (mean from 0.28 to 0.33). [POS011, POS012]
- The new activities are mutually exclusive: they never co-occur with each other in the later window (e.g., A17 and A18: cooccurrence 0, A_only 0.235, B_only 0.21). [REL029, REL030, REL037, REL044]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports a structural change in which the set of activities performed between A43 and A28 was replaced. In the earlier window, A15, A16, A25, A26 and A27 were always executed and co-occurred with each other, with A28 and with A43. In the later window, these activities are completely absent, and a new set of activities (A14, A17, A18, A19, A20) appears in a subset of traces, each leading to A28 and each preceded by A43. The new activities are alternatives to each other rather than co-occurring. This is directly shown by the occurrence, direction and relation evidence, and the number of qualifying items (94) far exceeds the 0.73 expected by chance. A competing explanation that cannot be fully ruled out is that the new activities are a different set of tasks that serve a similar purpose, but the replacement of the old set is unambiguous.

Other differences: The relative positions of A28 and A43 shifted slightly, but this is consistent with the change in the middle activities and does not alter the main conclusion.
